note: A damaged bridge and debris close two roads while seven emergency vehicles respond.
note_ko: 다리 손상과 잔해로 도로 두 곳이 막힌 가운데 긴급차량 7대가 출동해요.

scenario.name: earthquake
scenario.title: Earthquake · closures and emergency response
scenario.title_ko: 지진 · 다중 도로 통제와 긴급 출동
scenario.description: An earthquake at t = 1200 s damages the J3–J4 bridge (closed both ways until inspected at 3000 s) and drops debris on the cross street north of J1 (closed until 3600 s). Seven ambulances and fire trucks are dispatched from all sides and must find open routes, while lighter-than-peak traffic detours over the back street.
scenario.question: With several roads cut at once, do emergency vehicles still get through fast, and does the network recover?

controller.name: max_pressure
controller.label: Max-pressure
controller.description: Every 5 s, gives green to the axis with the larger pressure (cars upstream minus cars downstream, from loop detectors). No timing plan needed.
